# 1. Statement delivery protocol

**Adviser:** ⟦PERSON|Tovan Pellis⟧

| Version | Purpose | Approval |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Working copy | Correct factual errors | Client review |
| Signed copy | File and serve | Written authority |

1.1 The adviser must provide a complete working copy before seeking a signature. Corrections should identify the paragraph concerned and the wording that accurately reflects the client's recollection. A suggested change must not be accepted solely because it makes the account more convenient for either party.

1.2 The signed statement will be stored in the client folder. The document-management system preserves spaces in display text but encodes them in exported links. The following references were retained by the Word conversion:

- [Statement of ⟦PERSON|Liora Nesket⟧](https://bundle.invalid/clients/⟦PERSON|Liora%20Nesket⟧/signed.pdf)
